WEAPON ISSUED: Go to the ARMORY board on the north wall and press E (USE on a phone) to fit an attachment to your weapon. You carry one weapon at a time, issued part by part. Close it when you are done.
配发武器: 走到北墙的军械库招牌前按 E（手机点 USE），给你的武器装上一个配件。你每次只携带一件武器，按区域依次配发。选好后关闭界面。

WEAPON ISSUED: STEALTH: stay behind the dummy and hold E (USE) to knock it out: a longer hold keeps it down longer, and too long kills it. Or shoot it with your stun pistol.
配发武器: 潜行：躲在假人身后，按住 E（USE）将其击晕：按得越久昏迷越久，太久则会致死。或者用你的电击手枪射击它。

WEAPON ISSUED: CYBERWEAPON: aim at a dummy and fire (left click). It costs RAM and the stun jumps to the dummies around it.
配发武器: 网络武器：瞄准假人开火（左键）。它消耗 RAM，电击会跳到周围的假人身上。

WEAPON ISSUED: Accurate and steady. Right click aims down the sights.
配发武器: 精准稳定。右键可开镜瞄准。

WEAPON ISSUED: Rapid fire for close and middle range. Fire in short bursts.
配发武器: 适合近中距离的高射速武器。用短点射。

WEAPON ISSUED: Devastating up close and weak at range. Get in close.
配发武器: 近距离威力惊人，远距离则很弱。贴近了打。

WEAPON ISSUED: One powerful shot at long range. Right click zooms and SHIFT steadies the scope.
配发武器: 远距离的一发强力射击。右键放大，SHIFT 稳住瞄准镜。

WEAPON ISSUED: Steady and accurate at any range. Fire in controlled bursts.
配发武器: 任何距离都稳定精准。用受控点射。

WEAPON ISSUED: Nonlethal: a few shots knock a guard out instead of killing them.
配发武器: 非致命：几发子弹就能击晕守卫而不是杀死。

WEAPON ISSUED: A cyberweapon: aim and fire to stun a target and everything near it, for RAM.
配发武器: 网络武器：瞄准开火即可电击目标及其周围的一切，消耗 RAM。

WEAPON ISSUED: Hold the trigger to spin the barrels up. Huge firepower, slow to start.
配发武器: 按住扳机让枪管加速旋转。火力惊人，但起转较慢。
